points.description: States that the stack operation corresponding to enqueue is push (accept 'push operation', 'pushing', or an equivalent statement naming push as the insertion operation). A response that only describes adding/inserting an element at the top of the stack without naming push earns partial credit.
points.partial_credit: Partial credit for describing insertion at the top of the stack without naming push.

levels.says: Describes the operation as adding or inserting an element at the top of the stack (e.g. 'you add the item on top') but does not name it push.

rubric.notes: Full marks require naming push as the stack operation that corresponds to enqueue. A description of inserting at the top of the stack without the name push earns half marks. Any other operation (e.g. pop) or no answer earns no marks.
